_source: ADR 7.2.4 — special provisions concerning the carriage of packages (API field: specProvPackages, Table A column 16)

v_codes.V1: Packages — only in closed or sheeted vehicles or closed or sheeted containers.
v_codes.V2: Class 1 substances/articles requiring a transport unit with EX/II or EX/III vehicle(s) (choice depending on the quantity limits of 7.5.5.2); trailers meeting EX/II or EX/III requirements may be towed by a vehicle not meeting those requirements; for multimodal transport to/from ports/terminals, EX/II may be used in place of EX/III under conditions of consistency with the IMDG Code/RID/ICAO.
v_codes.V3: Freely flowing powdery substances and fireworks — container floor must be non-metallic or lined with a non-metallic liner.
v_codes.V8: See 7.1.7 (temperature control) — does not apply to substances of 3.1.2.6 stabilized by inhibition with an SADT >50°C, unless the temperature during carriage could exceed 55°C.
v_codes.V10: IBCs (Intermediate Bulk Containers) — only in closed or sheeted vehicles or closed or sheeted containers.
v_codes.V11: IBCs other than metal or rigid plastics IBCs — only in closed vehicles/containers or sheeted vehicles/containers.
v_codes.V12: IBCs of type 31HZ2 (31HA2/HB2/HN2/HD2/HH2) — only in closed vehicles or closed containers.
v_codes.V13: Substances in bags 5H1/5L1/5M1 — only in closed vehicles or closed containers.
v_codes.V14: Aerosols/gas cartridges for recovery/disposal (provision 327) — only in open or ventilated vehicles/containers.
v_codes.V15: IBCs (Intermediate Bulk Containers) — only in closed vehicles or closed containers.
